cd scratch && $PWD/../release/../TASK.json 2>/dev/null; cd .. ; python3 - <<'E'
s=open('scratch/c2.py').read()
s=s.replace('MONO = None','MONO = None\nTE = []      # columns to target-encode (out-of-fold in fit)\nTE_M = 100.0\nTE_ONEHOT_DROP = True')
s=s.replace('''    Z = prepare(state, X_train)
    kw = {}''','''    state["te"] = {}
    Z = prepare(state, X_train)
    y = np.asarray(y_train, dtype=float); prior = float(y.mean())
    for c in TE:
        key = X_train[c].astype("string").fillna("__na__").to_numpy()
        fold = np.random.RandomState(seed).randint(0, 5, len(y)); oof = np.zeros(len(y))
        for k in range(5):
            a = fold != k; pk = y[a].mean()   # prior and counts exclude the held-out fold (so each row's own label)
            g = pd.DataFrame({"k": key[a], "y": y[a]}).groupby("k")["y"].agg(["sum", "count"])
            mp = ((g["sum"] + TE_M * pk) / (g["count"] + TE_M)).to_dict()
            oof[~a] = [mp.get(v, pk) for v in key[~a]]
        Z["te_" + c] = oof
        g = pd.DataFrame({"k": key, "y": y}).groupby("k")["y"].agg(["sum", "count"])
        state["te"][c] = {"map": ((g["sum"] + TE_M * prior) / (g["count"] + TE_M)).to_dict(), "prior": prior}
    kw = {}''')
s=s.replace('''    return f.drop(columns=[c for c in DROPF if c in f])''','''    for c, d in state.get("te", {}).items():
        f["te_" + c] = [d["map"].get(v, d["prior"]) for v in X[c].astype("string").fillna("__na__")]
    drop = list(DROPF) + ([k for k in f.columns if any(k.startswith(c + "=") for c in TE)] if TE_ONEHOT_DROP else [])
    return f.drop(columns=[c for c in drop if c in f])''')
open('scratch/c3.py','w').write(s)
E
